title: The Shortest War in History Lasted Under 45 Minutes ⚔️ #shorts
description:
On 27 August 1896, Britain and the Sultanate of Zanzibar fought a war that lasted only about 38 to 45 minutes – the shortest war on record. Britain's ultimatum ran out at 9:00 in the morning, five Royal Navy ships opened fire on the palace, and the sultan's royal yacht Glasgow was sunk. The sultan, Khalid bin Barghash, escaped through the German consulate and was only captured by the British about 20 years later, in 1916.

Sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Wikipedia (Anglo-Zanzibar War), Guinness World Records, History Today, HowStuffWorks, Atlas Obscura, South African History Online

scenes.text: The shortest war in history was over in less than forty-five minutes. That's shorter than half a football match.
scenes.headline:
A WAR
UNDER 45
MINUTES

scenes.text: It was August eighteen ninety-six. The sultan of Zanzibar died, and a new sultan took the throne. But Britain wanted someone else.
Britain gave him an ultimatum. Step down by nine o'clock in the morning, or else.
scenes.label: THE DEADLINE

scenes.text: He refused. Five Royal Navy warships faced his palace, defended by about three thousand men.
Right after nine, the ships opened fire. The palace was hit, and the sultan's only warship, his royal yacht, was sunk.
After somewhere between thirty-eight and forty-five minutes, it was all over.
scenes.label: MINUTES

scenes.text: The twist? The sultan escaped through the German consulate. The British only caught him about twenty years later.
